info.title: Programmable Banking Sandbox API
info.description: A local sandbox emulating the Investec Programmable Banking APIs. Operations marked x-sandbox-only have no Investec equivalent. To test error handling, send X-Sandbox-Fault (429, 500, 502, 503, 504, timeout, timeout:<ms>, reset) or X-Sandbox-Latency (<ms>) with any /za request, or set random faults with PUT /faults.

post.description: Runs the published code. Any currency with an exchange rate works: the card code sees the purchase in its own currency, and the account is charged in rand. Declined up front if the card is stopped or the account can't cover the rand amount; an approved swipe places a pending hold (or posts immediately with settle: true). 422 when the currency has no exchange rate.
